svg.title: Voice activity detection
svg.desc: Chunk RMS, calibration, gate threshold and speech segments produced by the VAD of hmi_server.
svg.text: Voice activity detection, computed by hmi_pkg/nodes/vad.py
Synthetic input in 42 ms chunks (683 samples, as sent by the browser at 48 kHz). Every state below is the real VADProcessor output.
A segment ends after 450 ms of silence, so it always contains that hang-over: the 180 ms minimum-length test never rejects anything with the default settings,
and the 60 ms click becomes a 554 ms segment that is uploaded to Whisper. Gate and noise are estimated once per server start.
